FORGE.description: The first time you [gold]Forge[/gold] each combat, add [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. [gold]Forge[/gold] adds damage to it. [gold]Sovereign Blade[/gold] also grants [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold], [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold], [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold], [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Regen[/gold], and [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Vigor[/gold] when played.
FORGE.title: Forge
